note: libngspice (KiCad 10.0.6, econ-core, 2026-10-31) runs of OUR deck (pcb.custom.kicad_spice.build_deck) with the whole board at each temperature (.temp); "parts" = the board at 25 C with D1 at its own 100 C (instance temp=). Every 100th point kept. Reference for tmp-1 / tmp-2.

-40.deck:
.title Polari deck (kxc-3, from the ingested rows)
.include "diode.mod"
.temp -40
.tran 1u 10m

C1 /rect_out GND 100n
D1 Net-_D1-A_ /rect_out 1N4148
R1 /signal_in Net-_D1-A_ 1k
R2 /rect_out GND 100k
V1 GND /signal_in SINE(0 1.5 1k 0 0 0 0)
.end
